is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles funestus (Page 1: 'Mapping a Quantitative Trait Locus (QTL) conferring pyrethroid resistance in the African malaria vector Anopheles funestus').

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study does not genotype any of the specified target markers. It sequences partial fragments of kdr and AChE to check for mutations (finding no L1014 mutation in An. funestus) and uses custom microsatellites and local SNPs (e.g. 7P6P4, 3P6P3) solely as linkage mapping markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable genotype counts or frequencies for any target resistance marker in field populations are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: The genotyped mosquitoes used for resistance mapping are F2 progeny generated from crosses between laboratory colonies (FUMOZ-R from Mozambique and FANG from Angola; Page 8). Field samples from Malawi were only used for polytene chromosome in situ hybridization.

sub_country_location.evidence: Mentions Kela village, Chikwawa district in southern Malawi (Page 13) and Calueque in southern Angola (Page 8).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: States FUMOZ colony originated from Mozambique in 2000 and FANG colony from Angola in 2002 (Page 8).

assessment.summary: This study performs QTL linkage mapping for pyrethroid resistance using F2 progeny derived from crosses between laboratory colonies (FUMOZ-R and FANG) of Anopheles funestus. It does not genotype any defined target insecticide-resistance markers and does not report genotype data for field populations.
exclusion_reasons: Does not report any defined target insecticide resistance markers.
Genotyped samples are F2 progeny of laboratory colony crosses (FUMOZ-R x FANG), not field populations.
Lacks extractable target marker genotype frequency data for field-collected mosquitoes.
